description: Judge what a provider returned against the contract: every required deliverable present and non-empty, every declared digest and byte size matching, every JSON deliverable parsing, the provider named correctly, and every acceptance clause answered. Choose this the moment a provider returns work: it decides whether the delivery may be accepted and names every gap, before money is released or the work is passed to your own client. Do not choose this to write the acceptance criteria, to judge the visual quality of design work, or for a binary file supplied without its content or digest. Example requests: Check this subcontracted delivery against the contract before I accept it. | Did the provider return everything I ordered, and does it answer each acceptance clause? | Verify the digests and sizes in this delivery manifest and tell me what to reject.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key. Re-sending the same key returns the same job instead of running it twice.

acceptance_contract.description: The customer's acceptance_contract.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one key=value per line: provider, required_deliverables, acceptance. What was ordered: the provider, the required deliverables and the acceptance clauses. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

delivery_manifest.description: The customer's delivery_manifest.json, as text. Supported: JSON: {"provider": "...", "files": [{"path": "...", "content": "...", "sha256": "...", "bytes": 0}]}. What came back, as a manifest of files with their content and digests. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: Base64-encoded x402 payment payload (the value the HTTP interface puts in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header), signed for the amount in the payment requirement the first call returned. Required for a priced capability; nothing is charged until the work completes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_subcontract_delivery_acceptance

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Subcontract delivery acceptance
